preconditions.description: The number of names n is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(name) <= 100 for name in names)
preconditions.description: Each name has a length between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in name) for name in names)
preconditions.description: Each name contains only lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Impossible' or (len(stdout) == 26 and set(stdout) == set('abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz') and all(stdout.index(c) < stdout.index(d) if (c, d) in constraints else True for c, d in constraints))
postconditions.description: If no valid alphabet order exists, output 'Impossible'. Otherwise, output a permutation of 'a'-'z' such that for every adjacent pair of names in the input, the first differing character in the first name appears before the corresponding character in the second name according to the output order. If one name is a prefix of the next and the prefix comes first, no constraint is generated; if the longer name comes first, it is impossible.

postconditions.expression: not (any(names[i] == names[i+1][:len(names[i])] and len(names[i]) > len(names[i+1]) for i in range(len(names)-1)))
postconditions.description: The output is 'Impossible' if and only if there exists an adjacent pair where the first string is a prefix of the second but the first is longer (which is impossible in lexicographical order), or if the derived character constraints form a cycle.
